The MITC is RBL-CC-MITC-V2-29-10-2026 (29 Oct 2026) and the Cardmember Agreement RBL-CC-CMA-27-10-2026. The earlier rbl.mjs open question that the three Shoppers Stop drafts have no SOC revision date can now be answered, and the SOC and MITC also settle their late fee (12.5% of outstanding, min 5, max 1,300), over-limit fee (NIL) and fuel fee (1% above INR 10,000 a transaction, max INR 3,000). Point-value baselines are the lowest value that applies to every redemption (WSL 0.05, WSP 0.10, SalarySe 0.10, XTRA 0.10); the higher route values (0.25, 1.0, 0.20, 0.50) are in point_value_baseline_basis and redemption_matrix.
